view_transform_for_tone_checks: Standard, look None, exposure 0 (white card 0.90 linear)

M_BlackCloakV2_Wool.normal_convention: DirectX (green down) on disk; flip green in Blender, not in Unreal
M_BlackCloakV2_Wool.uv_note: UV0 = flat-pattern metres / 5.85 (unique, non-overlapping atlas); the 0.45 m slub tile repeats 13.0 times per UV unit
M_BlackCloakV2_Wool.roughness_note: roughness = ORM.G (x 1.0; the stage-1 kit's 'ORM.G + 0.0' is the same)
M_BlackCloakV2_Wool.ao_tex_channel: ORM.R (Unreal indirect only; Cycles computes its own occlusion)
M_BlackCloakV2_Wool.fray_note: the fringe rows along every cut edge (and every non-fringe vertex at V 0.97, opaque) sample the fray strip's alpha through UV1 (U = edge metres / 0.45, V = 1 at the cloth side). Unreal: Blend Mode Masked, clip 0.5, dithered, alpha-coverage preservation on the fray texture. A measurer that ignores these keys renders the fringe as solid cloth.
